sources.name: Open GPU Benchmarks
sources.notes: Per-GPU API records used, not dashboard game_summaries; repeats remain in the same series and are collapsed for evaluation.

sources.name: TechFuelHQ
sources.robots: Allow /; dataset terms explicitly permit reuse/training with attribution
sources.notes: First-party assertion; nine chart points, one repeated PT point merged. Manual OC, missing game builds/OS; not calibration-ready stock Windows data.

sources.name: OpenBenchmarking
sources.robots: search=yes, ai-train=no, use=reference; training crawlers disallowed
sources.notes: Training not permitted by checked Content-Signal; data license not established. Code GPL does not license submitted results. Legal page returned 403; no results fetched.

sources.name: FPSHQ
sources.robots: Disallow /api/; exceptions are limited to named landing/og-test paths, not general REST
sources.notes: Data page web access 403. No alternate hostname/proxy or forbidden API attempted. Median export combines review-derived rescaling and observations; not equivalent to raw measured pairs.

sources.name: BenchPress Data
sources.notes: Checked tree unchanged: reports/.gitkeep only. Baselines estimated, no measured reports.

sources.name: TechPowerup32 FPS dataset
sources.notes: 188 CSV rows inspected for provenance. No publisher URL, capture date, test-series ID, game build, RT/FG/OS metadata. Measurement status unverified; not labelled synthetic without evidence. CPU_Score units not documented.

sources.name: SteamFPS
sources.license: CC-BY-4.0 compilation; upstream rights explicitly retained by NOTICE
sources.notes: 241 claimed Deck measurements are upstream community fields. Upstream terms and distinction between target FPS and measured average unresolved; handheld domain cannot calibrate desktop Windows. No verdict-to-FPS conversion.

sources.name: DeckSettings reports
sources.license: GPL-3.0 repository; issue submission data grant not established
sources.notes: Report template requests target framerate, not necessarily measured average. No import or license inference from website source code.

sources.name: Kaggle FPS Benchmark
sources.notes: Dataset page not readable in web tool. Notebook Apache-2.0 license is not a dataset grant. No authenticated or challenge-bypass access.

sources.name: Hugging Face PCGameBenchmarks
sources.notes: Estimated FPS already identified in previous iteration; not measurements. Gameplay video datasets with fixed encoded 30 FPS are not hardware FPS benchmarks.

sources.name: TechSpot / Hardware Unboxed
sources.robots: Direct robots request failed TLS certificate verification
sources.notes: Priority 5500X3D comparison candidate; no chart values imported. Same review syndicated to Hardware Unboxed is one source family, not independent evidence. TLS verification not bypassed.

sources.name: Gamers Nexus
sources.robots: robots 200; no data reuse permission established
sources.notes: Priority CPU-dependent X3D comparative publication; no charts/OCR or FPS values imported. Terms candidate URL 404.

sources.name: iXBT
sources.notes: Comparative 5500X3D/5600X candidate. No structured dataset grant established; no values imported.

sources.name: ComputerBase
sources.notes: CPU/X3D/game review candidates; no additional measurements imported without reuse permission. Legacy constants remain legacy, not licensed new training evidence.
